messages:
gina: quick heads-up — proposal to deprecate the legacy 460/CLIENT_RATE_EXHAUSTED status we added in 2022. moving to single 429 with a structured error_code field. want alignment on rollout and telemetry migration

marty: +1 on consolidation. can you summarise why we need the switch now?

gina: main reasons: 1) SDKs/third-party libs don't recognize 460 so clients see unknown status. 2) console and alerts treat 429 as rate-related by default; 460 fragments dashboards. 3) simplifies routing & fallback rules across hosted/dedicated/private.

sophia: important: console dashboards rely on the top-level status for badging. if we keep 460 we need a duplicate badge mapping. prefer canonical 429 + error_code.

praveen: telemetry note — we need to keep the historical signal. plan: map existing 460 events to new tag error_code=RATE_EXHAUSTED_CUSTOM and keep original status in raw logs for 3 months. ops will change daily ETL to produce the tag so queries keep working.

gina: proposed timeline: week 0 announce + banner in console, week 2 SDK adapters shipped (js/py/ruby), week 4 start soft-canary (only apply mapping for 10% of requests), week 6 enforcement (emit 429 at edge). 6-week grace total before removing 460 from outputs.

marty: for rollouts -> what's the fallback if a private deployment can't accept 429? some on-prem customers patch edge routers based on numeric code.

sophia: we should add an opt-out flag in Private for 12 weeks, so on-prem can keep 460 until they upgrade. the control plane will show per-tenant deprecation status.

praveen: telemetry dashboard changes: rename metric "status_460_count" to "status_460_deprecated_migrated_to_429" and introduce "status_429_with_error_code_RATE_EXHAUSTED_CUSTOM". update dashboard queries and saved alerts. I'll open a PR with SQL diffs.

gina: SDK behaviour: map incoming 460 -> surface as RateLimitError with .code = "RATE_EXHAUSTED_CUSTOM" for 3 months. also log a warning once per process. example shim:

```
if (resp.status === 460) {
  const e = new RateLimitError('rate exhausted');
  e.code = 'RATE_EXHAUSTED_CUSTOM';
  throw e;
}
```

marty: console UX: we'll add a banner copy: "Planned change: status 460 will be replaced by 429 + error_code. See migration docs." Link to /docs/api/errors/migrate-460. Keep banner dismissible per-user but keep a tenant-level notice for admins.

praveen: metrics/alerts - action items: update runbook to treat 429+error_code=RATE_EXHAUSTED_CUSTOM as same as previous 460. change incident rules that used status code 460 as unique signal.

sophia: can we include a short migration helper in the console — a query builder that finds customers using 460 and surfaces contact info? ops-bot could export CSV for account execs.

ops-bot: I can generate a weekly CSV of tenants with >100 460s/day. want the first export next monday.

gina: question about client message text — do we want to change the RFC/body to include precise retry-after guidance? e.g., older 460 responses had no Retry-After. suggestion: include Retry-After when available and an "retryable": true field for SDKs.

marty: yes include Retry-After where we can compute it (quota windows) and add a clear "retryable": true/false. also add a short human-friendly message: "quota exceeded — try after Xs or contact support."

praveen: telemetry rename checklist I'm working on: saved queries, alerts, dashboards, bigquery ETL, graphite exports, billing counters. will post PR with list by EOD.

gina: ownership: eng-platform owns API response changes and banner + SDK adapter. eng-ml/serving teams need to update runtime mapping. ops to run tenant CSVs and handle exceptions for private. product/console will do banner + migration helper UI.

marty: any compliance/legal considerations? some customers rely on numeric codes for audit logs. bill -> product to confirm retention of raw numeric 460 in logs for 90 days before final deletion.

gina: yep we'll keep raw logs for 90d. final deletion only after legal sign-off.

praveen: risk register: 1) some infra (3rd party WAFs) treat 429 specially -> may throttle upstream. mitigation: staged canary and opt-out flags for Private. 2) SDKs older than adapter release will surface unknown status -> we add response header X-Deprecated-Status: 460 -> 429-mapping to help.

gina: next steps: PR for runtime mapping and header (pr 1234), console banner design (design ticket 5678), SDK adapter issues (js#234, py#345), telemetry SQL PR (sqldiffs/789). will announce in product and api-changes docs after approvals.

marty: sounds good. please file a short update in the status channel once banner is live and when canary starts. :thumbsup:

gina: will do. thanks all.
